shared_elements: low relief carving of figures against a plain ground
justification: Both are low reliefs organised with horizontal dividing bands and contain profile animals plus quadruped-and-figure imagery, but the specific content differs entirely: A shows a narrative procession of clothed human tribute-bearers with staffs and vessels leading a camel past a stylised tree, framed by rosette borders, while B shows an isolated stack of schematic zoomorphs (crouching predators, a bird with splayed wings, a long-necked bird) arranged vertically with no interaction, no clothing, no objects held, and no floral border. The correspondences are of the generic sort any relief tradition could produce independently.
